Browser Workspace Ownership: many canvas sessions, one shared persistence queue
|-- CanvasWorkspace owns sessions; MappingWorkspacePage controls visibility
|   |-- Startup restores workspace records and opens drafts before attaching persistence
|   |-- drafts[documentId] = metadata + stable CanvasSession
|   |   |-- Seed with document, canvas and history -> create session and register controller
|   |   |-- Metadata changes with the same session -> retain editing context
|   |   `-- Remove or replace session -> unsubscribe, unregister controller, dispose session
|   |-- First activation mounts MappingEditorCanvas(session) [rendering]
|   |   `-- Switching canvases hides previously mounted editors; sessions remain available
|   `-- workspace.controllers addresses each session by documentId
|       `-- Headless sessions use the same domain commands [canvas_commands]
|-- CanvasSession separates semantic state from live interaction
|   |-- Owns MappingDocumentController and cursor-copy state
|   |-- Exposes independently subscribable, read-only stores
|   |   |-- document     -> document reference; refreshes search/explorer draft entry
|   |   |-- presentation -> display and diagram views
|   |   |-- selection    -> selected items
|   |   |-- controls     -> canvas controls
|   |   |-- geometry     -> endpoint bounds, cell and controller snapshot version
|   |   `-- status       -> dirty flags and undo/redo availability
|   |-- Mounted editor owns live geometry and undo navigation [rendering]
|   |   `-- Pointer/camera samples do not publish session application state
|   `-- Controller notification -> synchronously publish changed stores
|       `-- canvasRevisionId changes -> session.onCommit -> workspace.onPersist([documentId])
|           `-- canvasRevisionId identifies a canvas checkpoint; snapshot.version is separate
|-- WorkspacePersistence translates live owners into incremental records
|   |-- Consumes workspace.onPersist(ids), including tracked metadata/lifetime changes
|   |   `-- For each affected canvas, ask controller.persistenceChanges(sessionCursor)
|   |       |-- Emit history/checkpoint changes; advance that session's cursor
|   |       |-- Include metadata, saved baseline and captured canvas view records
|   |       `-- New session under an existing ID -> reconcile obsolete history keys
|   |-- Consumes SourcePaneViewState notifications -> capture display/camera records
|   |-- Records workspace membership, activeDocumentId and transfers in the index
|   |-- Removed draft -> delete its document-prefixed records
|   `-- Deduplicate keys and skip already stored content-addressed items
|       `-- All canvases submit to the same RecordStorage.batch(changes)
|-- RecordStorage + WorkspaceStorage deliver records [persistence handoff]
|   |-- batch() updates local cache immediately; acknowledgement comes later
|   |   `-- Skip equal values; coalesce pending changes by key; debounce delivery
|   |-- One frozen batch in flight: {requestId, expectedRevision, changes}
|   |   |-- expectedRevision is the workspace record-store revision returned by transport
|   |   |-- requestId identifies this delivery attempt across retries
|   |   `-- New edits accumulate separately until the in-flight batch is acknowledged
|   |-- WorkspaceStorage reuses a worker to encode and POST /api/mapping/workspace/records
|   |   |-- Success -> advance storage revision and acknowledged sequence; release batch
|   |   |-- Transport/server uncertainty -> retain batch and retry with backoff
|   |   |   `-- Same requestId, expectedRevision and changes; worker retains encoded body
|   |   `-- HTTP 4xx -> definitive rejection
|   |       `-- Background scheduling stops on rejection or version/request-ID conflict
|   `-- flush() waits for the submission sequence captured at entry
|       `-- Resolution acknowledges those writes; rejection leaves delivery unresolved
|-- Acknowledgement has operation-specific consequences
|   |-- Ordinary edits update sessions before asynchronous workspace delivery
|   |   `-- Persisted editing history can still differ from the saved project baseline
|   |-- Prepared transfer/projection -> explicit storage commit -> install prepared UI state
|   |   `-- commit(): flush earlier writes, then await this transaction
|   |       |-- Ambiguous failure -> retry identical flight while storage remains open
|   |       `-- Definitive rejection -> restore prior cache, abandon transaction, throw
|   `-- Page Save -> sync/flush captured checkpoint -> check controller version unchanged
|       `-- publishMappingCheckpoint delegates project publication [persistence]
|           |-- Sends checkpoint ID, controller version and expected project revision ID
|           `-- Publication receipt updates the captured saved baseline
|               `-- Edits made since capture can remain dirty
`-- Shutdown follows ownership boundaries
    |-- Page becomes hidden -> flush view state and attempt storage flush
    |-- Pending view/storage changes or dirty/busy drafts -> request beforeunload warning
    |-- Page cleanup detaches persistence subscriptions and disposes sessions/view state
    |   |-- Locally owned storage -> attempt flush, then dispose records and worker
    |   `-- Injected storage -> external owner retains disposal responsibility
    `-- Cleanup attempts do not guarantee a flush on abrupt tab termination
